correctness.rationale: Rank <=2 embeds injectively into the 2D integer square with published maximum <=45. Every positive rank-three four-column circuit is uniquely its primitive signed-cofactor vector; all and only minimal sequences correspond to these vectors. Exhaustive C99 enumeration of 9,691,375 unordered supports finds 779,864 positive circuits, maximum 79, exactly 48 maximizers. Independent Python checks all 48 primitive cofactor relations and equality with the full 48-element signed-coordinate symmetry orbit, including a trivial stabilizer. Full source and run outputs are included.
